job: **Dinis's login and his lane to the conductor.** Study pki.sgit.ai (its pages and `agents/pki-agent.mjs`) and reuse its code: a key made in the browser (or a passkey), private half never leaves it; a page where Dinis writes feedback on any page, sealed to incident.conductor@'s public key (`data/keys.json`), delivered through an SG/Send append lane the conductor drains each wake; the reverse path (the conductor seals to Dinis's key). Design first in `SECURITY.md` (threats, what is public, what a stolen token can do), then build. Vault creation needs an SG/Send token: ask Dinis via status; never commit one.
